extension.author: ChasKa
extension.license: GNU/GPL v3 or any later version
extension.description: Profile photos for Joomla 5 and 6: safe upload, WebP conversion and per-group permissions. The three plugins ("User - MiFoto" for the profile form, "Content - MiFoto" for the {user} tag, "Engage - MiFoto" for Akeeba Engage comments) are switched on the first time; the module "MiFoto - User photo" can be placed anywhere. Then set the MiFoto permissions. Uninstalling keeps the photos and their tables.
